This 4lite fixed LED downlight offers versatile and efficient lighting with 4 selectable colour temperatures from 2700K to 6000K. It is ideal for electricians installing in bathrooms, kitchens, porches, and covered outdoor areas, providing robust IP65 water and dust protection. The integrated 7W LED delivers 640-730 lumens and is dimmable for adjustable light levels. A 60° beam angle ensures wide light distribution. Installation is simplified by easy-install push-fit terminals and an integral driver. This downlight is fire-rated for 30, 60, and 90 minutes, ensuring safety. A matt white bezel is supplied.
